privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CSSA Hub is the internal work platform of the UCSB Chinese Students and Scholars Association (UCSB CSSA), for CSSA members only. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.
privacy.collectGoogle: Your name, @ucsb.edu email address, and profile picture from Google Sign-In. We only request basic profile and email access; we never access your Gmail, Google Drive, or other Google data.
privacy.collectProfile: The Chinese name, English name, bio, uploaded profile photo, requested departments, and note you enter on the platform.
privacy.collectContent: Messages, reactions, files and chat-app responses (sign-ups, polls, meeting availability) you send on the platform, the edit history of your messages, and your departments and roles.
privacy.useBody: This information is used for sign-in, showing the organization roster, approving members, and internal CSSA communication. Your profile photo, names, and bio are public and are shown on CSSA's public website. Beyond that, we do not sell, rent, or share your information with anyone outside CSSA, and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy.oversightBody: The Presidium can view all content on the platform; department leads can view messages and uploads from members of their departments. This is disclosed at sign-up and requires your consent, and every such view is recorded in an audit log.
privacy.storageBody: Data is stored on Convex (convex.dev) cloud infrastructure and encrypted in transit. Only approved CSSA members can access the platform. Chat messages are deleted automatically after 15 days unless an admin or lead extends a chat's retention (up to one year). Uploaded files are limited to 15 MB and deleted 15 days after they are sent; file links work without signing in, so anyone holding a link can open the file until then.
privacy.deleteBody: When you leave CSSA, your account is deactivated. You can also request deactivation yourself in Settings; the Presidium reviews it and decides whether the files you uploaded are kept or deleted. To have your personal information or content deleted, contact the CSSA Presidium.
privacy.contactBody: For questions about this policy, contact the UCSB CSSA Presidium.

onboarding.preApproved: You have been pre-approved to join:
onboarding.noticeIntro: CSSA Hub is an internal work platform for UCSB CSSA, not a private messaging app. By creating an account, you understand and agree that:
onboarding.noticePresidium: The Presidium (主席团) can view all content on the platform, including messages you send (DMs and group chats), files you upload, and your assignment submissions.
onboarding.noticeLead: Department Leads (部长) of departments you belong to can view the messages you send (DMs and group chats), files you upload, and your assignment submissions as a member.
onboarding.noticeAudit: Every oversight view is recorded in an audit log.
onboarding.noticePrivate: Please do not share personal or sensitive information unrelated to CSSA work on this platform.
onboarding.consent: I have read and agree to the notice above
onboarding.noticeIcon: Every monitored chat shows an eye icon in its top-right corner; hover over it to see who can view that chat.
onboarding.noticeRetention: Chat messages are kept for 15 days by default and then deleted automatically. Admins or leads can extend a chat's retention up to 1 year.
onboarding.noticeRecall: Messages can't be deleted. You can recall one within 5 minutes (the chat shows "xxx recalled a message"). Edited messages keep an edit history that everyone in the chat can see.
onboarding.noticeFiles: Uploaded files and images are limited to 15 MB and are deleted 15 days after sending. File links open without signing in, so don't share them outside CSSA.
onboarding.noticeProfile: Your avatar, names and bio are public and appear on CSSA's public website.
onboarding.updatedSubtitle: We've added details about chats, files and oversight. Please read and agree again to continue.
